title: Galaxy Note 20 5G "waiting to connect" BLE authentication errors
body:
Attempting to use nightly release edd2c2a-2020.09.04 with a 8K0### series transmitter on a Galaxy Note 20 5G with Android 10 and August 1 Security path for a NA region phone.

xdrip never gets past _waiting to connect_ message on UI when attempting to authenticate, logs updated via xdrip+
repeating errors show in event list:
`09:23 authentication notification throwable: (CHECK_AUTH) com.polidea.rxandroidble2.exceptions.BleDisconnectedException: Disconnected from MAX=XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX with status 19 (GATT_CONN_TERMINATE_PEER_USER) 20202-09-23 09:23:34`

comments.body:
No, I have not gotten it to work, still get a rotating loop of  Brain State: Waiting to connect Errors: [counter keeps updating with failures] and Bluetooth Link: Connecting.  Tried everything from forgetting device, restarting collector, to no avail.
